A.population: same complete patches and actual assignments as frozen readout
A.attributes: EEG Hann alpha power fraction of 1-45 Hz; HbO slope per second; separately on actual X and paired S/O
A.template: training per-ID mean of branch attribute residual relative to dataset/site/visible RMS bin; shrink toward zero with 16 patches
A.coverage: training >=20 patches and >=3 people; readable if >=3 development people and positive matched-background improvement in mean subject MSE and strict majority of people; descriptive on this development panel
A.members: select by training frequency 10th/50th/90th percentiles among eligible IDs; additionally illustrate worst eligible supported held-out word as a labelled failure
A.waves: deterministic up to 128 train and 128 held-out members per illustrated word; fitted training wave template and matching training backgrounds by dataset/site/RMS bin; raw and time-centered views in frozen training coordinates
A.families: each ID assigned by quartile of its training mean branch attribute shrunk to global mean with 16 patches; thresholds weighted by training emissions; unseen maps to global mean

B.task: real paired mental arithmetic and explicit BL cues in Single-Trial
B.panel: G0 admitted frontal F3/F4 and posterior P3/P4; separate electrode regions; prefrontal measured relative HbO/HbR from AF3Fp1 and AF4Fp2
B.context: event -6 to +24 s; entire 30s bidirectional encoder offline; complete valid observation inputs inside QC admitted nonoverlapping G0 score crops
B.primary: posterior EEG-S high-alpha family occupancy contrast MA vs BL in [2,10) relative to pre [-4,0)
B.secondary: stage profiles and entry/exit; independent continuous EEG alpha fraction and measured Hb changes using native event clocks

C.complement: B; B plus frozen S or O code vector; additive both; additive plus one-hot interaction of training-defined S/O families; identical fixed ridge 0.01 in standardized residual coordinates, X/S/O same attribute
C.sequence: predict final measured X attribute from first 14 full-window S-family or O-family IDs; compare four-family occupancy, added directed bigrams and dwell histogram, added trigrams; next disjoint crop first patch sensitivity
C.controls: 10 fixed surrogates per complete window, preserve bag, exact directed transition counts with endpoints, or exact run sequence and within-family run lengths

D.panel: Single-Trial MA/BL; simultaneous left/right frontal EEG channels paired in aggregate with prefrontal HbO/HbR; one regional panel
D.eeg: crop [cue-26,cue+4); last three two-second patches of actual S/O code families and continuous theta/alpha/RMS from identical full EEG input
D.Hb: independent downstream-v2 offline measured relative Hb; target two-second mean after cue+4+lag minus mean in [cue+2,cue+4)
D.baseline: last three two-second two-color means before cue+4, condition, session, trial order; region fixed; same label and phase in all comparisons
D.selection: lag 2/4/6 seconds by lowest grouped training-CV baseline normalized error; signs learned on training only; fixed standardized ridge 0.01
D.nulls: same subject/session/condition/phase cross-trial EEG derangement with disjoint contexts; separate within-record EEG timeline shifted -43s with no cue realignment within 4s; identical complete support
D.interpretation: offline conditional association; full-record preprocessing and 30s model context preclude causal lead inference

statistics: report paired subject effects, average trials within condition and session for event tests; equal datasets for four-dataset summaries; label secondary endpoints exploratory; fixed primary event contrast exact subject sign-flip
stopping: execute A-D once; keep exclusions, empty support and adverse results; no protected confirmation, tokenizer training or capacity search
